verdict.rationale: The published pages tie the core online filing flow to an Online Services account. Web File for Form CT-5 says to first create an Online Services account, and withholding returns are filed using the account. Quick Pay and online notice response are described, but no evidence states they work without an account or through a file-number or notice-number entry path.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
